question: What protection holds for one who has been bitten by great serpents with respect to poison entering the body?
premises: A person may be bitten by great serpents.
Poison would normally enter the body.
In this case poison does not enter the body.
inference: Even if bitten by great serpents, poison does not enter the body.
uncertainties: Source of this protection not stated here
plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if one has been bitten by great serpents.
